selection: All four neighbors are reported. For each rule compare the two neighbors with the original five-day rule and each real account with its own full-window, ex-post mean-equity fixed control. Support for reducing drawdown beyond static exposure requires strictly smaller full-window drawdown than the control. Interpret CAGR cost jointly; no threshold selection on observed periods.
controls: Constant cap set from dynamic actual exposure, maximum gap 0.005, one correction if required. Matching uses no P&L. Both original rules rerun on current quotes.
full_cost: 4 new candidates, 2 parent reproductions, 6 fixed controls; at most 6 matching corrections and 2 technical retries. Zero fits. Both predecessors were closed. Prior rounds observed test and extension. 5 fits, 56+10 completed simulations in market-risk and threshold rounds.
formula: Market NAV < MA60 AND breadth20 < 0.4 triggers 45%; k consecutive false observations restore 90%. Absolute signal is eligible mean raw forecast, rolling k days (min periods 1); strictly below zero triggers 45%, else 90%. Use prior close.
input_check: Previous frozen SHA checked for models, score series, market diagnostics and execution source. Quote database uses current version; compare repeated parent controls to archived records.
